info.title: Tasker API
info.description:
REST API for Tasker, a self-hosted team work management platform.

## Conventions

- **Versioning:** all endpoints live under `/api/v1`. Only additive
  changes (new optional fields, new endpoints) occur within a minor
  version; breaking changes would introduce `/api/v2`.
- **Errors:** every non-2xx response uses RFC 9457 Problem Details
  (`application/problem+json`) with an optional `errors` extension array
  of `{field, message}` entries for validation failures.
- **Pagination:** list endpoints use `page` (1-based) and `page_size`
  (1-100, default 25) and return `{items, page, page_size, total}`.
  Results are server-paginated; clients must not assume they can fetch
  an entire collection at once.
- **Sorting:** `sort` accepts a whitelisted field, `order` is
  `asc`/`desc` (default per endpoint).
- **Identifiers:** UUIDv7 strings.
- **Timestamps:** unix epoch milliseconds (UTC integers).
- **Dates:** `YYYY-MM-DD` strings.

## Authentication

Cookie-based sessions. `POST /auth/login` sets an HttpOnly
`tasker_session` cookie; browsers send it automatically. State-changing
requests are additionally checked against allowed origins (CSRF defense).
Public self-registration may be disabled per deployment; members are
then provisioned by administrators via `POST /teams/{team_id}/members`.

post.description: Sets the session cookie. Rate limited per client IP.

Returns 403 when the deployment disables public registration
(the default). Members provisioned by admins do not need this.

put.description: Revokes all other sessions of the user on success.

get.summary: Tasks assigned to the current user across all teams

200.description: Paginated assigned tasks with team/project context.

get.summary: List teams the caller belongs to

post.description:
Administrator-assisted provisioning: if no user exists with the
email, one is created using `temp_password` (min 10 chars), which
the administrator hands to the member out-of-band. If the user
exists, only the membership is added. Granting the `owner` role
requires the caller to be Owner.

patch.description:
Owners can change any role; Admins can change roles of non-owner
members but can never grant or modify `owner`. The last owner
cannot be demoted and members cannot change their own role.

delete.description:
Owners can remove anyone (except themselves); Admins can remove
Manager/Member roles only. The last owner cannot be removed. The
member's task assignments are cleared.

owner_id.description: Project owner; must be a team member. Defaults to caller.

patch.summary: Update project (Owner/Admin/Manager; archived projects are read-only)

get.summary: List project tasks (root tasks; server-side pagination)

parameters.name: assignee_id
parameters.description: User id, or `none` for unassigned tasks.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring search over title and description.

post.summary: Create a task (all roles; archived projects reject)

get.summary: Kanban board — tasks grouped by status

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Maximum cards per column; totals are unaffected.

200.description: Board columns in canonical status order.

get.summary: Task detail with labels and subtasks (requires team membership)

patch.description:
Owner/Admin/Manager can update any task. Members can update tasks
they created or are assigned to, but may only assign tasks to
themselves and cannot edit labels. Every changed field is recorded
in the task's activity history.

delete.description:
Owner/Admin/Manager can delete any task; members only tasks they
created. Subtasks are deleted with their parent (documented
cascade semantics). The deletion is recorded as project-level
activity.

post.description: The parent must be a root task in the same project.

get.description: Always responds 200 while the process runs; does not touch the database.

Problem404.description: Resource not found (or not visible to the caller).

Problem.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details with a field-error extension.

parent_task_id.description: Subtask parent; must be a root task in the same project.

assignee_id.description: Team member id; empty string clears the assignment.

completed_at.description: epoch ms; set while status is done

subtasks.description: Present in task detail responses (one nesting level).
